known_text: It was nice to relax for a while.

use.known: It was nice to relax for a while after the meeting.
use.target: 开会以后放松一会儿很好。

use.known: She said she wants to relax this weekend at home.
use.target: 她说她想这个周末在家放松。

use.known: If you have time, you should try to relax a bit.
use.target: 如果你有时间，你要试着放松一下。

use.known: I like to relax in the evening after a long day.
use.target: 我喜欢晚上工作一整天以后放松。

use.known: Everyone needs to relax sometimes when they are busy.
use.target: 大家忙的时候有的时候都需要放松。

use.known: Did you have time to relax last Sunday at home?
use.target: 你上星期天在家有时间放松吗？

use.known: It was nice to relax for a while after working so hard.
use.target: 这么努力工作以后放松一会儿很好。

use.known: She asked if we can wait for a while before we leave.
use.target: 她问我们是不是可以走之前等一会儿。

use.known: If you rest for a while, you will feel much better.
use.target: 如果你放松一会儿，你会觉得好很多。

use.known: I talked with my friends for a while on Saturday night.
use.target: 我星期六晚上和我朋友说了一会儿话。

use.known: Everyone sat down for a while after the meeting ended.
use.target: 开会完以后大家都坐了一会儿。

use.known: Did you have a chance to relax for a while this week?
use.target: 你这个星期有机会放松一会儿吗？

use.known: It was very nice to relax after working all week.
use.target: 工作一整个星期以后放松一会儿很好。

use.known: She said the meeting was very good and went well.
use.target: 她说开会很好，过得很好。

use.known: If you work very hard, you should rest sometimes.
use.target: 如果你工作很努力，你有的时候要放松。

use.known: I was very tired after going out on Saturday night.
use.target: 我星期六晚上出去以后很累。

use.known: Everyone was very happy when they heard the good news.
use.target: 大家听说好的消息的时候都很开心。

use.known: Did you know the work was very difficult to finish?
use.target: 你知道工作很难完成吗？

use.known: It was nice to relax for a while after such a busy week.
use.target: 这么忙的星期以后放松一会儿很好。

use.known: She hoped everyone had a nice time at the meeting.
use.target: 她希望大家开会过得好。

use.known: If the work is good, we can finish early today.
use.target: 如果工作好，我们今天可以早完成。

use.known: I had a good time with my friends last Sunday.
use.target: 我上星期天和我朋友过得好。

use.known: Everyone said the food at the meeting was very good.
use.target: 大家都说开会的东西很好。

use.known: Did you have a nice weekend with your friends?
use.target: 你和你朋友周末过得好吗？
